headlines.headline: L&T Q2 FY27 results: Net profit surges 33% YoY to ₹5,202 crore; order intake increases 28%
headlines.summary: Revenue from operations grows 16% driven by accelerated progress in the various businesses in the Projects, Products & Manufacturing (PPM) portfolio, L&T said.

headlines.headline: L&T shares surge over 6% on strong Q2 numbers; order inflows rise 28%
headlines.summary: The company on Tuesday reported a 32.5% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹5,202.10 crore for the quarter ended September 2026, driven by higher revenue.

headlines.headline: SENSEX drops over 700 points, NIFTY50 below 22,600 dragged down by IT shares
headlines.summary: Infosys, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Tata Consultancy Services, Reliance Industries, Bharti Airtel, ITC and HCL Technologies were top drags on the SENSEX.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 28: Vedanta, Jio Platforms, RIL, L&T, Piramal Pharma, Maruti, Max Financial Services
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms is set to make its much-awaited stock market debut on the BSE and NSE at 10 AM on Wednesday, October 28, marking a landmark moment for India's primary market after its mega IPO.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms set for historic debut at 10 AM: What Akash Ambani told investors
headlines.summary: The Jio Platforms' issue became the first among India’s mega IPOs to achieve full subscription within just 100 minutes of opening and the first global offering to cross the one-crore application mark.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms Q2: Digital services major to announce results on October 30 after Wednesday’s market debut
headlines.summary: Parent company Reliance Industries (RIL), in a stock exchange filing, said that Jio Platforms will announce its September quarter (Q2 FY27) results on Friday, October 30.

headlines.headline: Reliance Industries sets October 30 for Q2 FY27 results; NCD fundraise on board agenda
headlines.summary: The board will also consider raising funds through the issuance of listed, secured or unsecured, redeemable non-convertible debentures (NCDs) on a private placement basis, in one or more tranches.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Oct 27: Asian Paints, Coal India fall 2%; Tata Consumer Products jumps 7%
headlines.summary: On October 23, the SENSEX declined by 8.08 points or 0.01% to close flat at 73,598.67, while the NIFTY50 fell by 3.45 points or 0.015% to end at 22,749.75.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 end rangebound session on a flat note; Tata Consumer, Bharti Airtel top gainers
headlines.summary: The SENSEX traded in a band of 584 points and NIFTY50 index touched an intraday high of 22,830 and a low of 22,636 as NIFTY50 October futures and option contracts expired.

headlines.headline: Reliance Industries awards ‘Mega’ order to VA Tech Wabag for Jamnagar plant; check how shares are performing
headlines.summary: VA Tech Wabag shares jumped after the company announced that it had secured a ‘Mega’ order from Reliance Industries (RIL) for the design, engineering, supply, installation, pre-commissioning, commissioning and performance guarantee test run (PGTR) of a desalination plant at Jamnagar, Gujarat.

headlines.headline: L&T bags Dhaka Metro order worth up to ₹10,000 crore; here’s how stock is faring ahead of Q2 earnings
headlines.summary: L&T’s transportation infrastructure business vertical secured major design and build orders for two key systems packages of the Dhaka Mass Rapid Transit Development Project.

headlines.headline: L&T Q2 results: Revenue could see double digit growth driven by new order inflow and execution; Key focus on West Asia crisis and its impact
headlines.summary: Larsen & Toubro will announce its Q2FY27 results on Tuesday, October 27. Experts expect double-digit revenue growth, but net profit could stay flat as geopolitical issues in West Asia weigh on project execution and margins.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 and SENSEX open in red on Tuesday; Reliance shares decline ahead of Jio Platforms IPO listing
headlines.summary: The pullback was largely driven by index heavyweight stocks like HDFC Bank (-0.45%), Sriram Finance (-0.6%), HCL Technologies (-0.8%), and Infosys(-2.4%). Meanwhile, the index breadth for NIFTY50 tilted towards losers, with 34 stocks opening in red, 11 in green, and 5 unchanged.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms listing: How Reliance Industries and other group stocks are faring ahead of mega IPO debut on October 28
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms' IPO closed with bids for 22.19 times the shares on offer, as total demand across the public issue and anchor investor placement crossed ₹7.4 lakh crore and applications approached a world-beating 1.39 crore in an unprecedented response to the Reliance Industries-backed digital services company.
